solution_summary: But there's still a long way to go before this vision of the future is realized. Although machines already deliver several terabytes of data every day, the potential within that data isn't yet being exploited. "Some of our customers are sitting on huge troves of data they're not using, simply because they lack the capacity and expertise," explains Claudio Gusmini elunic supports its customers in digitizing for Industry 4.0. The shopfloor.io platform is used for data collection and evaluation as well as for networking. To use the data more efficiently, the digital machine portal was extended to shopfloor.GPT based on Azure OpenAI Service. Specialized and customizable AI agents support elunic's customers as autonomous problem solvers: fast, reliable, and flexible. This solution leads to increased productivity for customers by saving 15 minutes per request.
